mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior month, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and corporate earnings pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has been above 4.5% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and increase in residential finance (RSAFS) signals weakening housing demand and shifting consumer spending patterns, jointly predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining HOUST and rising RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.5%), labor market tightness accelerates wage growth and inflation, prompting monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior month indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profit growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO has declined over the prior month, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0% for three consecutive months, it signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL has been above 3.0% for three consecutive months, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During strong industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105.0), robust supply chains expand corporate margins, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 105.0, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) falls below 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a tight labor market that accelerates wage growth and inflation, prompting monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.
